title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds at sixty-six thousand sixty-one dollars with fear dominant at a thirty-three reading on the index. Hashrate sits at eight hundred sixty-six point eight exahashes, showing sustained miner strength into the US session. Mempool backlog reaches eighty-six thousand seven hundred seventy-four transactions while fees stay compressed at three satoshis per byte, keeping the chain efficient at block nine hundred fifty-nine thousand one hundred fifty-nine. No major breaks on the tape.
